## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines and Agnostic Contract

- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new TypeScript or lint warnings (`pnpm check-all`)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`pnpm test`)
